dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いやにご機嫌だね」
dialogues.en: "Why are you here anyway? Still in the morning."
dialogues.text: "Why are you here anyway? Still in the morning."

dialogues.jp:
別に笑うつもりじゃないんだけど、自然と顔が
そうなってしまう。
dialogues.en:
"I've got nothing to do. Besides, it's boring to stay at
home."
dialogues.text:
"I've got nothing to do. Besides, it's boring to stay at
home."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「と言うか、なんで午前中なのに、朝倉がここ
　にいるのかな？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you gonna have a graduation party or something?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you gonna have a graduation party or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いやぁ、いろいろやることは終わっちゃって。
　２年生とかはまだ授業あるし。家にひとりで
　いても、つまんないんですよ」
dialogues.en: "No such plans."
dialogues.text: "No such plans."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「やれやれ。付属生活の最後だってのに相変わ
　らず“かったるい”ってヤツかい？」
dialogues.en:
"This is your last year on this campus. Don't spend it just
goofing around."
dialogues.text:
"This is your last year on this campus. Don't spend it just
goofing around."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なんなら、何か学園史に残るようなことを考
　えましょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to do something big -- like historic?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to do something big -- like historic?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「……いいよ、あんたはろくでもないことをし
　そうだから」
dialogues.en: "No thanks. I don't trust you with that."
dialogues.text: "No thanks. I don't trust you with that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたし、観てたテレビが、臨時ニュースで潰
　されるのは嫌いなんだ」
dialogues.en: "Too bad. I could do something really newsworthy."
dialogues.text: "Too bad. I could do something really newsworthy."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なおさら残念」
dialogues.en:
"I hate to be interrupted by breaking news when I'm watching
my favorite show on TV."
dialogues.text:
"I hate to be interrupted by breaking news when I'm watching
my favorite show on TV."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、天枷がこっちへ来るまで暇なら、あた
　しの仕事を手伝ってよ。バイト代払うから」
dialogues.en: "Sorry to hear that."
dialogues.text: "Sorry to hear that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いいんすか？　講師がそんなことをして」
dialogues.en:
"Why don't you help me out while waiting for Amakase? I'll
pay you."
dialogues.text:
"Why don't you help me out while waiting for Amakase? I'll
pay you."

dialogues.jp: ……さいですか。
dialogues.en: "Are you allowed to do that?"
dialogues.text: "Are you allowed to do that?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「やることは単純明快。あたしが書いている最
　中の天枷のレポートをまとめてくれればいい」
dialogues.en: "I'm the law here."
dialogues.text: "I'm the law here."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「最重要機密なんじゃなかったんスか？」
dialogues.en: No objection...
dialogues.text: No objection...

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そういう部分は見せないの。任せるのは朝倉
　がもう知ってる部分だけだから」
dialogues.en:
"It's easy. You just put together the report on Amakase I'm
working on."
dialogues.text:
"It's easy. You just put together the report on Amakase I'm
working on."

dialogues.jp: 言って、暦先生が、いたずらっぽく微笑む。
dialogues.en: "Isn't that supposed to be Top Secret?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that supposed to be Top Secret?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それに見せたってどうせ、内容なんかわかん
　ないでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"You'll be working on something you already know about,
anyway you wouldn't be able to guess what parts are Top
Secret, would you?"
dialogues.text:
"You'll be working on something you already know about,
anyway you wouldn't be able to guess what parts are Top
Secret, would you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いやぁ、わかるかもしれないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Maybe... I would..."
dialogues.text: "Maybe... I would..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そういう台詞は、せめて杉並や水越よりいい
　点をとってから言ってくれ」
dialogues.en:
"Save your breath. You can only say that when you start to
outperform Suginami and Mizukoshi on exams."
dialogues.text:
"Save your breath. You can only say that when you start to
outperform Suginami and Mizukoshi on exams."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは。この歳でボクの頭脳の力が知れ
　渡っては、悪の組織に利用されてしまいます
　よ。まずはそのための力を蓄えて……」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. If my intelligence became known to everyone, some
bad guys might find out and try to exploit it. That's why
I'm training myself to fight against those..."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. If my intelligence became known to everyone, some
bad guys might find out and try to exploit it. That's why
I'm training myself to fight against those..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃ、あたしは授業に行ってくるから、パソ
　コンで今開いている画面のテキストデータを
　日付ごとにまとめといて」
dialogues.en:
"I've got to go to class. Sort that data on the screen by
date, will you?"
dialogues.text:
"I've got to go to class. Sort that data on the screen by
date, will you?"

dialogues.jp: ……無視かよ。ナイーブな｛おれ／生徒｝の心が傷つくぜ。
dialogues.en: I haven't finished my monologue...
dialogues.text: I haven't finished my monologue...

dialogues.jp:
先生は、書類をまとめると、白衣をひるがえし
て部屋を出ていった。
dialogues.en:
After sorting some files out on the desk, Koyomi-sensei left
the room.
dialogues.text:
After sorting some files out on the desk, Koyomi-sensei left
the room.

dialogues.jp:
俺は先生の椅子に座り、パソコンと向かい合う。
そんなに経験があるほうではないが、マウスを
操作し、キーを叩く程度はできる。
dialogues.en:
I sit on her chair and begin to work. I don't have much of
work experience, but typing isn't a hard thing to do.
dialogues.text:
I sit on her chair and begin to work. I don't have much of
work experience, but typing isn't a hard thing to do.

dialogues.jp: 「うあぁ……肩がいてぇ」
dialogues.en: "Oh... I've got a stiff back."
dialogues.text: "Oh... I've got a stiff back."

dialogues.jp: 慣れない事務作業をすると、肩に来るな。
dialogues.en: This administrative work hurts my shoulders.
dialogues.text: This administrative work hurts my shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
レポートは結構量があって、まとめるのがひと
苦労だった。
dialogues.en:
It was quite a bit of work because there were a lot of
reports to put together.
dialogues.text:
It was quite a bit of work because there were a lot of
reports to put together.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ただいまぁ」
dialogues.en: "I'm back."
dialogues.text: "I'm back."

dialogues.jp: お昼前になって、ようやく先生が帰ってきた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei came back right before noon.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei came back right before noon.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あれ？　元気ないねぇ。そんなに難しい仕事
　を頼んだつもりは、なかったんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
"What's up? You look tired. I hope I didn't give you too
much work to do."
dialogues.text:
"What's up? You look tired. I hope I didn't give you too
much work to do."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do I look tired?"
dialogues.text: "Do I look tired?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんとなく。今朝は笑ってたのにさ」
dialogues.en: "Sort of. Compared with this morning when you were smiling."
dialogues.text: "Sort of. Compared with this morning when you were smiling."

dialogues.jp:
そういう風に見えちゃうか。そうかもしれない
けど。
dialogues.en: I have no idea how I look most of the time.
dialogues.text: I have no idea how I look most of the time.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お昼、食べるでしょ？　買ってきたよ」
dialogues.en: "You want lunch, right? I got you something."
dialogues.text: "You want lunch, right? I got you something."

dialogues.jp:
先生がそう言って、机の上にサンドイッチやら
おにぎりやらの入った袋を置いた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei puts a bag full of food on the desk.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei puts a bag full of food on the desk.

dialogues.jp:
「……先生は、美春の記憶のこと、どう思いま
　すか？」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei, what do you make of Miharu's memories?"
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei, what do you make of Miharu's memories?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そのことか」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that thing..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, that thing..."

dialogues.jp: 先生が妙に納得した顔をする。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei gives me a serious look.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei gives me a serious look.

dialogues.jp:
「やっぱり、美春には『天枷美春』の記憶はな
　いんですか？　それが、美春の身体の不調を
　引き起こしてるんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you really think Miharu has no memories of Miharu
Amakase? And is that the reason why she gets sick?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you really think Miharu has no memories of Miharu
Amakase? And is that the reason why she gets sick?"

dialogues.jp:
先生は、ため息を吐き、もうひとつの椅子に腰
を降ろした。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei sighs deeply and sits on the other chair.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei sighs deeply and sits on the other chair.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「前も言ったけれど、あたしが楽観的な見方を
　するわけにはいかないからね、立場上」
dialogues.en: "As I said before, I can't always be 100% positive on this."
dialogues.text: "As I said before, I can't always be 100% positive on this."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「天枷に、記憶のデータが入っていないという
　のは設計上の紛れもない事実だ。不調もそれ
　が原因だと考えるのが一番わかりやすい」
dialogues.en:
"It's an architectural truth that Amakase has no memory
data. I think her shutting down can be attributed to that."
dialogues.text:
"It's an architectural truth that Amakase has no memory
data. I think her shutting down can be attributed to that."

dialogues.jp:
先生のレポートには、これまで俺が報告してき
たことが細大漏らさずに記されていた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's report has all the detailed descriptions
that I told her about.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's report has all the detailed descriptions
that I told her about.

dialogues.jp:
美春の不調のこと。その原因について。そして、
その結果、予想されること……。
dialogues.en:
Miharu's health condition, its cause and effect, and
predictions.
dialogues.text:
Miharu's health condition, its cause and effect, and
predictions.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「造ったあたしが言うのもなんだけど、あの人
　工知能はまだ未知数なんだ。人間の脳だって、
　まだまだ不明なことだらけだし」
dialogues.en:
"Artificial intelligence is uncharted territory. Regarding
our own brains, there are a lot of things we don't
understand."
dialogues.text:
"Artificial intelligence is uncharted territory. Regarding
our own brains, there are a lot of things we don't
understand."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「アレは、そういう｛あいまい／曖昧｝なテクノロジーを含め
　て造られているんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"She was built on such a fuzzy technology as well. In fact,
there may be a possibility that some kind of memory data
slipped into her system."
dialogues.text:
"She was built on such a fuzzy technology as well. In fact,
there may be a possibility that some kind of memory data
slipped into her system."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生はそこで言葉を切り、じっと俺のほうを
見つめた。
dialogues.en: "So that means..."
dialogues.text: "So that means..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まあ実際、記憶データのようなものが紛れて
　いる可能性もないわけじゃない」
dialogues.en:
"The possibility works both ways. Maybe there is, and maybe
not."
dialogues.text:
"The possibility works both ways. Maybe there is, and maybe
not."

dialogues.jp:
カチリとライターのふたが開く。オイル独特の
匂いが漂ってきた。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei lights a cigarette up. I can smell something
oily.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei lights a cigarette up. I can smell something
oily.

dialogues.jp:
「あの……信じてもらえないかも知れないけど、
　俺、時々、人の夢を見ることがあるんです」
dialogues.en:
"Uh... You may not believe this, but sometimes I find myself
in other people's dreams."
dialogues.text:
"Uh... You may not believe this, but sometimes I find myself
in other people's dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「夢を見る？」
dialogues.en: "Other people's dreams?"
dialogues.text: "Other people's dreams?"

dialogues.jp: ｛けげん／怪訝｝そうな暦先生に、俺は頷いた。
dialogues.en:
"While sleeping, somebody else's dream just gets into in my
dream. I know it sounds ridiculous, but it's true."
dialogues.text:
"While sleeping, somebody else's dream just gets into in my
dream. I know it sounds ridiculous, but it's true."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、別に否定はしないよ。正面切って信じ
　てるとも言わないけどさ。そういう類の話を
　他にも知ってるから」
dialogues.en:
"I can either ignore that or believe it, but I've heard of
that kind of story before."
dialogues.text:
"I can either ignore that or believe it, but I've heard of
that kind of story before."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「俺……美春の夢を見たんです。最初は子供の
　頃の俺と音夢と美春の３人で遊んでいる夢」
dialogues.en:
"I was in Miharu's dream. Nemu, Miharu and I were all kids
and playing together."
dialogues.text:
"I was in Miharu's dream. Nemu, Miharu and I were all kids
and playing together."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そして、夕べまた見たんです。最初の夢より
　もっと明確な夢です。昔、ある場所で美春と
　一緒に遊んだときの夢です」
dialogues.en:
"Then I had a dream again last night. It was much clearer
this time. Miharu and I were playing somewhere."
dialogues.text:
"Then I had a dream again last night. It was much clearer
this time. Miharu and I were playing somewhere."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「それで、朝倉は天枷の記憶について、肯定的
　だったんだね」
dialogues.en: "No wonder you were so sure about Amakase's dream."
dialogues.text: "No wonder you were so sure about Amakase's dream."

dialogues.jp: 俺は無言で頷いた。
dialogues.en: I nodded yes.
dialogues.text: I nodded yes.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「夢なんてモノも実際はまだはっきりしない。
　夢は、様々な情報を処理している時の情報の
　流れを見ているものだっていう見方もある」
dialogues.en:
"There is so much stuff we don't know yet about dreams. Some
people say dreams are like a flow of information running
through our brains when they're processing information."
dialogues.text:
"There is so much stuff we don't know yet about dreams. Some
people say dreams are like a flow of information running
through our brains when they're processing information."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「実際は、あたしだってわからないから否定的
　な意見で通させてもらってるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Since we can't explain this, I have no choice but to play
on the safe side."
dialogues.text:
"Since we can't explain this, I have no choice but to play
on the safe side."

dialogues.jp: ぷはぁと、天井に向けてケムリが吐かれる。
dialogues.en: The smoke Koyomi-sensei exhales floats up to the ceiling.
dialogues.text: The smoke Koyomi-sensei exhales floats up to the ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃ、天枷が記憶を持ってるってほうが、
　あたしだって嬉しいさ。研究だって進むし、
　何よりあの子が喜ぶからね」
dialogues.en:
"Honestly, I'd be happy if Amakase truly did have her
memories because it could advance our research, but most of
all, it'd make Amakase happy."
dialogues.text:
"Honestly, I'd be happy if Amakase truly did have her
memories because it could advance our research, but most of
all, it'd make Amakase happy."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「だからこそ、敢えて言うよ。思い出探しなん
　てやめな」
dialogues.en:
"So let me get this straight. Stop searching for her
memories."
dialogues.text:
"So let me get this straight. Stop searching for her
memories."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en:
"Amakase is a working prototype. She was not built to
function on a long term basis anyway."
dialogues.text:
"Amakase is a working prototype. She was not built to
function on a long term basis anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「天枷はプロトタイプだ。あくまで『本人』の
　代わりなんだから、もともと長期運用を想定
　して設計されたわけじゃない」
dialogues.en: "What does that mean?"
dialogues.text: "What does that mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「というと……」
dialogues.en:
"She is not going to live for long, and Amakase knows it
too."
dialogues.text:
"She is not going to live for long, and Amakase knows it
too."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「その寿命は短いってこと。天枷だって言わな
　いかもしれないけど、それは知ってるよ」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そんな、だって……」
dialogues.en:
"It's not unique to Amakase. We'll all have to say goodbye
to people we love someday. No one is an exception."
dialogues.text:
"It's not unique to Amakase. We'll all have to say goodbye
to people we love someday. No one is an exception."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「別に天枷に限ったことじゃない。別れなんて
　モノは誰にだってあるさ。あたしにだって、
　クラスの連中だってそうだよ」
dialogues.en: "It's a matter of when we say it."
dialogues.text: "It's a matter of when we say it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと早いか、ちょっと遅いかの違いだけ」
dialogues.en:
"Overburdening the brain will shorten her life. If her
disorder continues, that's going to critically shorten her
life."
dialogues.text:
"Overburdening the brain will shorten her life. If her
disorder continues, that's going to critically shorten her
life."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「負担をかけるということは、いわば命を削る
　行為だ。これ以上、エラーが続くようなら、
　間違いなく天枷の寿命は縮まる」
dialogues.en:
"Why would one want to shorten one's life on purpose? Is
that logical even though we all say goodbye in the end
anyway?"
dialogues.text:
"Why would one want to shorten one's life on purpose? Is
that logical even though we all say goodbye in the end
anyway?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en:
"Don't you forget what I said today, Asakura. Especially, if
you truly love Amakase."
dialogues.text:
"Don't you forget what I said today, Asakura. Especially, if
you truly love Amakase."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いくら別れが確定的だと言っても、それをわ
　ざわざ自分で縮めることはないだろう？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉も、天枷のことが好きなら、その辺をも
　う少し考えてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Don't you love her?"
dialogues.text: "Don't you love her?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Wait. How would you know that...?"
dialogues.text: "Wait. How would you know that...?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「天枷のこと、好きなんだろう？」
dialogues.en: "My hunch was right."
dialogues.text: "My hunch was right."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ちょ、ちょっと待ってくださいよ、なんでそ
　んなこと……知って――」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、やっぱりそうなんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Amakase looked very happy today. So I thought something
very nice must've happened."
dialogues.text:
"Amakase looked very happy today. So I thought something
very nice must've happened."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、カマをかけられたことに気づいた。

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いやあ、天枷も今日はやけにご機嫌だったか
　らさ。なんかあったんだろうって推察してた
　けど」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha. I think it's a good thing."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha. I think it's a good thing."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Don't you think it's weird? Miharu is a robot."
dialogues.text: "Don't you think it's weird? Miharu is a robot."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「がらにもなく照れるなよ。いいことじゃん。
　あたしは賛成だよ」
dialogues.en: "No, I don't. Do you think it's weird, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "No, I don't. Do you think it's weird, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「先生は変に思わないですか？　美春はロボッ
　トだってのに」
dialogues.en: "I don't know. It just happened, and I love her now."
dialogues.text: "I don't know. It just happened, and I love her now."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「別に。朝倉だって、なんとも思っていないん
　だろう？」
dialogues.en:
"There's nothing wrong about that. What's important is your
feelings."
dialogues.text:
"There's nothing wrong about that. What's important is your
feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、普通に……気がついたら、好きに
　なってたっていうか」
dialogues.en: "Amakase looked so happy and excited. So did you guys..."
dialogues.text: "Amakase looked so happy and excited. So did you guys..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「だったら何の問題もないだろ。大切なのは、
　お互いの気持ちなんだからさ」
dialogues.en: "Well, yesterday..."
dialogues.text: "Well, yesterday..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「と言うか、天枷もご機嫌ってことは、やっぱ
　アレだよね」
dialogues.en: "Teehee. Did you guys kiss? Oh, I envy you guys!"
dialogues.text: "Teehee. Did you guys kiss? Oh, I envy you guys!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……その、昨日」
dialogues.en: "Oh, no!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, no!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「くくく、若いっていいねぇ。うらやましいよ。
　で、キスとかしたの？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, not yet?! You should go for it, Asakura!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, not yet?! You should go for it, Asakura!"

dialogues.jp: この人は、まったく……。
dialogues.en: "S-Sensei!"
dialogues.text: "S-Sensei!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あはは、悪い悪い――」
dialogues.en: "Just kidding."
dialogues.text: "Just kidding."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「でも、だからだよ」
dialogues.en: "But... That's why..."
dialogues.text: "But... That's why..."

dialogues.jp: 先生が不意に真面目な顔つきに戻る。
dialogues.en: Suddenly Koyomi-sensei looks at me seriously.
dialogues.text: Suddenly Koyomi-sensei looks at me seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「天枷のことが大事なら、そのことをもっとよ
　く考えてくれ」
dialogues.en:
"If you care about Amakase, you've got to think what I said
today."
dialogues.text:
"If you care about Amakase, you've got to think what I said
today."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ないかもしれない記憶を思い出すということ
　も、身体に負担を与えるけど……」
dialogues.en:
"It'll be a burden on her if she tries to get memories that
don't exist."
dialogues.text:
"It'll be a burden on her if she tries to get memories that
don't exist."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「記憶を思い出せば、それも確実に負担になる
　ことは覚えておくんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Furthermore, if she gets her memory back, it'll still be a
huge burden on her. Remember that."
dialogues.text:
"Furthermore, if she gets her memory back, it'll still be a
huge burden on her. Remember that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en:
"As I said before, it's not possible with today's technology
to implant someone's memory into someone else's."
dialogues.text:
"As I said before, it's not possible with today's technology
to implant someone's memory into someone else's."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「言ったろ？　今の技術じゃ、人間の記憶を移
　植すること自体、無理なんだ」
dialogues.en:
"You can imagine what would happen if you put more stuff
into a bag full of stuff already."
dialogues.text:
"You can imagine what would happen if you put more stuff
into a bag full of stuff already."

dialogues.jp: そんなことをすれば、袋は破れて、モノは――。
dialogues.en:
Eventually, the bag would get torn apart. Then things inside
would be...
dialogues.text:
Eventually, the bag would get torn apart. Then things inside
would be...

dialogues.jp: 俺は頭を強く横に振った。
dialogues.en: I shake my head hard.
dialogues.text: I shake my head hard.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そこのところ、よくわかった上で、行動して
　ほしいんだ」
dialogues.en: "You must make the right decision."
dialogues.text: "You must make the right decision."

dialogues.jp: 灰皿にタバコが押しつけられる。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei puts her cigarette out on the ashtray.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei puts her cigarette out on the ashtray.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしだって、天枷は娘みたいなものなんだ
　から……」
dialogues.en: "Amakase is like a daughter to me..."
dialogues.text: "Amakase is like a daughter to me..."

dialogues.jp: 先生はすっと立ち上がり、窓のそばへ立った。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei stands by the window.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei stands by the window.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「一年中、同じ景色が続くのは、この島くらい
　のものだろうね」
dialogues.en:
"It's only on this island where you have the same view
throughout the whole year."
dialogues.text:
"It's only on this island where you have the same view
throughout the whole year."

dialogues.jp:
窓の外は、相変わらず、桜の花びらがひらひら
と舞っていた。
dialogues.en:
Outside the window, I see cherry blossom petals fluttering
in the wind.
dialogues.text:
Outside the window, I see cherry blossom petals fluttering
in the wind.

dialogues.jp:
思い出探し……。やっぱり、美春のためには、
やめさせるほうがいいのかな。
dialogues.en:
Looking for her memories... I guess I should stop her from
doing it.
dialogues.text:
Looking for her memories... I guess I should stop her from
doing it.

dialogues.jp:
どうにかまとめ終わったレポートを眺めながら、
俺はそう思った。
dialogues.en: While looking down at the report, I wonder what to do.
dialogues.text: While looking down at the report, I wonder what to do.

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生の忠告◆
dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi◆

dialogues.jp:
暦先生から思い出探しをやめるように忠告され
た。
dialogues.en: "Nothing much."
dialogues.text: "Nothing much."

dialogues.jp:
もともと短い美春の寿命。それをさらに縮める
行為だから、美春のことが好きならその辺をも
う少し考えて欲しいと。
dialogues.en:
"You're not convincing, especially with that grin on your
face."
dialogues.text:
"You're not convincing, especially with that grin on your
face."

dialogues.jp:
思い出探し……。やっぱり、美春のためには、
やめさせるほうがいいのかな？
dialogues.en: I didn't even know I was smiling.
dialogues.text: I didn't even know I was smiling.
